case.summary: Case CASE-010 involves three card-not-present transactions (4012172, 4012173, 4012174) on card SC-03010-K950 totaling $644.95 in exposure. The real-time risk model scored transaction 4012172 ($269.17, domestic) at 0.89 [EV-6b32b777]. That transaction originated from a previously unseen device (Samsung SM-G973F) [EV-f1eb0a33] and used an anonymous proxy connection routed through Argentina [EV-6033a1af]. Three online transactions occurred on the card within 48 hours of the flagged transaction [EV-ac09571d]. The customer reported they did not authorize the purchases and still possess the physical card [EV-8fff1e67]. Prior fraud history includes one confirmed case for this customer/card (CC-4321) [EV-73a2e90a] and the same device profile appearing in another confirmed fraud case [EV-78a6dcbd]; six prior closed cases share the card_not_present_new_device pattern [EV-54faf744].

sar.narrative: Suspicious activity is reported for customer SC-03010, card SC-03010-K950, involving three card-not-present transactions (4012172, 4012173, 4012174) totaling $644.95. Transaction 4012172 triggered a real-time risk score of 0.89 [EV-6b32b777] and was initiated from a new device fingerprint (Samsung SM-G973F map400 Playlist for Android) not previously associated with the account [EV-f1eb0a33]. The connection used an anonymous proxy IP geolocated to Argentina [EV-6033a1af], a tactic consistent with identity masking. Three online transactions occurred within a 48-hour window [EV-ac09571d], indicating a burst of unauthorized activity. The cardholder confirms they did not make the purchases and retain physical possession of the card [EV-8fff1e67]. The customer and card have one prior confirmed fraud case (CC-4321) [EV-73a2e90a], and the device profile has been linked to another confirmed fraud case [EV-78a6dcbd]. Six prior closed investigations exhibit the same card_not_present_new_device pattern [EV-54faf744]. The combined indicators — new device, anonymized connection, velocity, customer denial, and repeat device/customer fraud history — support a finding of coordinated card-not-present fraud.
